title: Demo reminders are response-only: send_reminder/remind_applicant mutate nothing, so the awaiting list contradicts the success toast
evidence: demo_store.gleam: `pub fn remind_applicant(store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String,) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(1, 0)) }` and `pub fn send_reminder(...) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(2, 1)) }` (store returned unchanged); `pub fn awaiting(_store: DemoStore, vacancy_id: String,)` is a hardcoded static list per vacancy_id. client.gleam ApiReturnedReminder refetches awaiting 'so reminded rows flip to Reminded ✓' via demo_api.fetch_awaiting.
detail: After 'Remind all', the toast claims reminders sent but the refetched static list still shows Emma Doyle un-reminded — the real flow's visible state change never happens in demo.
recommended_fix: Store awaiting applicants in DemoStore and flip reminded/followed_up flags on send_reminder/remind_applicant, mirroring the real API's effect.
